problem_statement: Build a brand-new /newsletter page from scratch on the EV0 Astro theme (gndx__ev0-astro-theme). The route /newsletter does not exist yet (404/empty in baseline). Construct the full page reusing the site's shared Base layout so it inherits the existing Header navigation (Home/About/Tags/Categories) and Footer, matching the site's Tailwind zinc design system. The page has a hero with headline + description and a subscribe form, then a 'Past issues' section that lists inline static newsletter issues as cards. Add a topic filter bar (All issues / Astro / Tailwind / TypeScript) that filters the issue cards client-side and updates a live 'Showing ...' count. The page must be mobile-clean (no horizontal overflow at 390px) and must render identically to sibling pages' shared chrome.
required_content: Reuse the shared Base layout so the page shows the same Header nav (Home, About, Tags, Categories) and Footer as sibling pages (cross-page consistency)
An h1 hero headline 'The EV0 Newsletter'
A description paragraph starting 'One short email, every week.'
A subscribe form with an email input and a 'Subscribe' button
A topic filter bar with buttons: All issues, Astro, Tailwind, TypeScript (each with a unique data-topic attribute)
A live count heading (h3) reading 'Showing all 6 issues.' by default
Six inline static issue cards, each with a title (h3), a date, and a one-line blurb
Client-side filter: clicking a topic button shows only matching cards and rewrites the count to 'Showing N issues on <Topic>.'
Mobile layout with zero horizontal overflow at 390px

The six issue-card titles (each an h3) are: 'Astro Islands, explained', 'View Transitions in practice', 'Content Collections deep dive', 'Utility-first layouts that scale', 'Dark mode without the flash', 'Strict types for happier refactors'
design_constraints: Reuse src/layouts/Base.astro (shared Header + Footer chrome, ViewTransitions, global.css)
Use the site's Tailwind zinc palette and spacing utilities (max-w-screen-lg container, rounded-lg cards, zinc borders/text)
Rebind the filter handler on astro:page-load (ViewTransitions is enabled site-wide)
Data is inlined as a static array — no live API / getCollection fetch

Palette tokens (Tailwind zinc): page background white rgb(255,255,255) with rgb(250,250,250) surfaces; body text zinc-700 rgb(63,63,70) and headings zinc-800/900 rgb(39,39,42); muted/secondary text zinc-500 rgb(113,113,122); card borders zinc-100 rgb(244,244,245); the primary Subscribe button is a solid zinc-900 rgb(24,24,27) pill/rounded button with white text; topic filter buttons are rounded-full (9999px) pills with a zinc border, the active one filled zinc-900
author_notes: 方案A: baseline lacks /newsletter (bare empty stub, no Base layout); reference implements the full page via Base layout with a working topic filter; bad is byte-identical to reference except the filter click handler is not wired (buttons inert) so it fails ONLY interaction_assertions. Cross-page consistency enforced as dom_assertions binding shared nav 'About' link + footer 'GNDX' link on BOTH desktop_newsletter AND sibling desktop_about. @astrojs/sitemap removed from astro.config.mjs in all 3 workspaces (Node 22 offline build:done crash, #18ae). Three workspaces md5-distinct on source.
